name: DataCite_get_doi
description: Get metadata for a research dataset or publication by DOI from DataCite. DataCite is the primary registry for research data DOIs, covering datasets, software, samples, and other research outputs deposited in repositories like Zenodo, Dryad, Figshare, and thousands of institutional repositories. Returns title, creators, affiliations, publication year, resource type, subjects, funding information, and related identifiers. Essential for finding research data linked to publications, understanding data provenance, and discovering datasets in a field.

doi.description: DOI of the research output (e.g., '10.5281/zenodo.4088438', '10.5061/dryad.234', '10.6084/m9.figshare.1000050'). Include full DOI without URL prefix.

resourceTypeGeneral.description: General resource type (Dataset, Software, Text, etc.)

bibtex.description: BibTeX entry type for citing the dataset, e.g. 'misc'. Note that a dataset is 'misc' in BibTeX, so a reference manager will not call it a dataset.

schemaOrg.description: schema.org type, e.g. 'Dataset'. What a search engine sees.

citationCount.description: How many times DataCite has recorded this dataset being cited. 0 means none recorded, which is not the same as none existing: only citations deposited with DataCite are counted.

created.description: When the metadata record was created in DataCite.

dates.description: Every date the depositor supplied, each with 'date' and 'dateType' - 'Collected', 'Issued', 'Available', 'Updated', 'Submitted'. A 'Collected' value may be a range, e.g. '1998-01-01/2024-12-31', which is when the data was gathered rather than published. 8 such entries on the measured record.

downloadCount.description: Downloads aggregated the same way, and subject to the same caveat.

isActive.description: False once the DOI has been withdrawn by its registrant.

metadataVersion.description: How many times the metadata has been revised in DataCite; 0 for a record never updated since deposit.

partCount.description: How many records are parts of this one; non-zero marks it as a collection.

partOfCount.description: How many records this one is a part of.

prefix.description: The DOI's registrant prefix, e.g. '10.5281' (Zenodo). Identifies the repository without parsing the DOI string.

published.description: The publication date as the depositor gave it, which may be a bare year ('2020') rather than a full date.

referenceCount.description: How many works this dataset itself cites.

registered.description: When the DOI was first registered with DataCite, e.g. '2020-10-14T14:51:55.000Z'. The publicationYear is what the depositor claims; this is when the DOI actually came into being.

schemaVersion.description: The DataCite metadata schema the record was deposited against, e.g. 'http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4'. Which fields are even allowed to be present.

source.description: How the metadata reached DataCite: 'mds' (deposited through the Metadata Store), 'api', 'fabricaForm' and so on. Where the record came from, which bears on how complete it is.

state.description: Registration state: 'findable' (indexed and resolvable), 'registered' (resolvable but not indexed) or 'draft' (not yet registered). A draft DOI does not resolve, and nothing else in the record says so.

updated.description: When the metadata record was last changed. Dataset metadata is mutable, so this says how stale the rest of the reply may be.

versionCount.description: How many later versions of this record exist.

versionOfCount.description: How many records this one is a version OF. 1 means it is itself a version of something else, so it is not the top of its chain.

viewCount.description: Views DataCite has aggregated from the repository's usage reports. 0 where the repository files no reports.

xml.description: The complete DataCite XML record, base64-encoded. Everything the depositor submitted, including fields this reply does not break out.

rightsList.description: Licence terms, each with 'rights', 'rightsUri' and where given the SPDX triple below. An empty list means the depositor stated no licence, which is not the same as public domain.

relationships.description: JSON:API relationship links for the record - client, provider, media, references, citations, parts, partOf, versions. The addresses to follow for the things the *Count fields only count.

name: DataCite_search_dois
description: Search DataCite DOI records by keyword and resource type. Returns exact total matches plus page continuation. DataCite exposes only an approximately 10,000-record ranked window for broad searches; compare metadata.accessible_results with total_results and refine the query when metadata.upstream_truncated is true.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'RNA-seq transcriptomics', 'CRISPR knockout mouse', 'climate change temperature')

resource_type_general.description: Filter by resource type: 'Dataset', 'Software', 'Text', 'Image', 'Workflow', 'Model', 'PhysicalObject', 'Collection'. Maps to DataCite 'resource-type-id' parameter.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (1-1000; default 10). DataCite silently clamps larger values to 1000.

page_number.description: One-based page number (default 1). Continue with metadata.next_page; DataCite silently coerces 0 to 1.

citationCount.description: How many times DataCite has recorded this dataset being cited. 0 means none recorded, which is not the same as none existing: only citations deposited with DataCite are counted.

created.description: When the metadata record was created in DataCite.

dates.description: Every date the depositor supplied, each with 'date' and 'dateType' - 'Collected', 'Issued', 'Available', 'Updated', 'Submitted'. A 'Collected' value may be a range, e.g. '1998-01-01/2024-12-31', which is when the data was gathered rather than published. 8 such entries on the measured record.

downloadCount.description: Downloads aggregated the same way, and subject to the same caveat.

identifiers.description: Identifiers other than the DOI, each with 'identifier' and 'identifierType', e.g. {'identifier': '31622', 'identifierType': 'ICPSR Study Number'}. The repository's own accession, which is how the dataset is cited in its home system.

isActive.description: False once the DOI has been withdrawn by its registrant.

language.description: Language of the dataset's content as an ISO code, e.g. 'en'.

metadataVersion.description: How many times the metadata has been revised in DataCite; 0 for a record never updated since deposit.

partCount.description: How many records are parts of this one; non-zero marks it as a collection.

partOfCount.description: How many records this one is a part of.

referenceCount.description: How many works this dataset itself cites.

schemaVersion.description: The DataCite metadata schema the record was deposited against, e.g. 'http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4'. Which fields are even allowed to be present.

sizes.description: Sizes as free text, e.g. ['12 MB']. Empty where the depositor gave none.

source.description: How the metadata reached DataCite: 'mds' (deposited through the Metadata Store), 'api', 'fabricaForm' and so on. Where the record came from, which bears on how complete it is.

state.description: Registration state: 'findable' (indexed and resolvable), 'registered' (resolvable but not indexed) or 'draft' (not yet registered). A draft DOI does not resolve, and nothing else in the record says so.

updated.description: When the metadata record was last changed. Dataset metadata is mutable, so this says how stale the rest of the reply may be.

version.description: The depositor's own version label, e.g. 'v6'. A free-text string, not a number.

versionCount.description: How many later versions of this record exist.

versionOfCount.description: How many records this one is a version OF. 1 means it is itself a version of something else, so it is not the top of its chain.

viewCount.description: Views DataCite has aggregated from the repository's usage reports. 0 where the repository files no reports.

relatedIdentifiers.description: Links to other works, each with relationType, relatedIdentifier and relatedIdentifierType, e.g. {'relationType': 'IsVersionOf', 'relatedIdentifier': '10.3886/icpsr31622'}. This is where the paper that describes the dataset, and the version it supersedes, are named.

rightsList.description: Licence terms, each with 'rights', 'rightsUri' and where given the SPDX triple below. An empty list means the depositor stated no licence, which is not the same as public domain.

contributors.description: Contributors other than the creators, each with a name and contributorType, e.g. {'name': 'McMaster University', 'contributorType': ...}. Measured on 1 of 5 records. The hosting institution and data manager appear here rather than in the author list.

relationships.description: JSON:API relationship links for the record - client, provider, media, references, citations, parts, partOf, versions. The addresses to follow for the things the *Count fields only count.

name: DataCite_search_datasets
description: Search DataCite for datasets across repositories. Defaults to resource type Dataset and returns exact total matches plus continuation. Broad searches expose only an approximately 10,000-record ranked window; refine the query when metadata.upstream_truncated is true.

query.description: Search query for datasets (e.g., 'iron intake physical function older adults', 'COVID-19 genomic surveillance', 'soil microbiome diversity'). Searches across titles, descriptions, subjects, and creator names.

resource_type.description: Override resource type filter. Defaults to 'Dataset'. Other options: 'Software', 'Text', 'Image', 'Collection', 'Workflow', 'Model'.

publisher.description: Filter by publisher/repository name (e.g., 'Zenodo', 'Dryad', 'figshare'). Note: uses free-text matching.

year.description: Filter by publication year (e.g., 2024, 2023). Returns datasets published in that year only.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (1-1000; default 10)

name: DataCite_get_dataset
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific research dataset by its DOI from DataCite. Returns comprehensive metadata including title, creators with affiliations, description, subjects, publication year, publisher/repository, resource type, funding references, related identifiers (linked publications, software, etc.), rights/licenses, and the landing page URL. Use this to get full details about a dataset found via DataCite_search_datasets, or when you have a specific DOI for a research dataset.

doi.description: DOI of the dataset (e.g., '10.5281/zenodo.4088438', '10.5061/dryad.234', '10.6084/m9.figshare.1000050'). Include full DOI without URL prefix (no 'https://doi.org/').

oneOf.description: Required so this branch stops matching the error envelope. oneOf needs exactly one branch to match, and with nothing required here a correct {status, error} result satisfied both branches and failed validation. Measured present in all 12 successful payloads.

rightsIdentifier.description: Machine-readable licence id, e.g. 'cc-by-4.0'. The only form that can be checked automatically; the 'rights' text cannot.

rightsIdentifierScheme.description: Scheme the identifier belongs to, e.g. 'SPDX'.
